properties.rationale: Deferred on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28. Accepted and not dropped: adopt has no completeness measure, so "we adopted it" cannot be told from "we adopted what we happened to read", where reflow's RE-06 computed extraction coverage and gated at 80%. Deferred rather than built because the honest measure has to be expressed in what adopt actually models — unmapped entry points, unmodelled contracts, untouched modules — and a naive nodes-per-LOC ratio would punish the coarse-but-honest granularity adopt correctly requires. That design work is the increment.
